basis: User requested smaller batches and no review of every page.
selection: Use the existing table/equation inventory, extraction-failure signals, saved drafts and retrieval needs to choose concrete targets.
visual_review: Inspect selected source regions and necessary continuations or context only. Keep distinct visual recheck and source/content digests.
coverage: A checked crop verifies its record, not all content on its page. Keep whole-page coverage as historical audit metadata, not an outstanding work queue.
completion: Close and report the selected batch before starting another; do not automatically fan out across manuals.
